label: SYNTHETIC AUDIO — computer voices, not a real consultation
about: Windows text-to-speech reading a scripted consultation about a fictional adult patient (Ramesh Kumar, the primary patient of npm run demo:jury). No person was recorded. The text below is the script, for documentation and tests; the application shows only what the speech model transcribes from the audio.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Good morning, Mr. Kumar. What brings you in today?

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: Doctor, I have had a fever for three days and a mild cough.

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: No chest pain. Slight breathlessness when I climb stairs.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Are you taking your regular medicines?

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: Yes, I take my diabetes and blood pressure medicines regularly.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Do you have any allergies to medicines?

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: Yes, I am allergic to penicillin. I get a rash.
